steps: Register for the Rockland Trust Refer a Friend program.
Share your personalized referral link with friends and family.
Your friend registers and opens a qualifying checking account via the link.
After your friend completes all qualifying activities, $50 is deposited to your account.
timing: For accounts opened and qualifying activities completed July 1-Sept 30, 2026, the bonus is credited by Dec 31, 2026.
when_cash_arrives: For accounts opened and qualifying activities completed July 1-Sept 30, 2026, the bonus is credited by Dec 31, 2026. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
